title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
description:
S01 E03 — Homemade Bagels with Egg Salad and Cherry Chocolate Mousse
Jamie's Thai red chicken & squash traybake uses clever tips to get more for your money, a sardine puttanesca proves budget doesn't mean basic, a bagel recipe creates a low-cost lunch and his cherry chocolate mousse is a little bit of low-cost luxury.

title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
description:
S01 E02 — Caprese Chicken Burgers and Pork and Fennel Ragu
From crispy, herby Caprese chicken burgers to golden spinach pies, creamy pork & fennel ragù with fresh pappardelle, and a comforting tinned peach cobbler with fruit-rippled cream, Jamie proves budget-friendly cooking can be utterly delicious.

title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
description:
S01 E05 — Silky Eggplant Noodles and Nostalgic Custard Tart
Jamie makes an epic toad in the hole with onion gravy, silky aubergine noodles with peanuts and mint, a comforting and thrifty chicken, sausage & white bean bake with cabbage cake, and a nostalgic jam treacle tart with old-school custard.

title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
description:
S01 E04 — Creamy Broccoli & Blue Cheese Gnocchi and Beef & Potato Pasties
With inspiration to make everyday ingredients into feasts for less, Jamie shares his version of beef & potato pasties, a homemade gnocchi using leftover cheese, fish cakes made from the store cupboard and a retro dessert brought bang up to date.

title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
description:
S01 E01 — Hearty Chicken Pot Pie and French Toast Crumpets with Bacon
From a cosy chicken hotpot with braised cabbage to cheesy French-toast crumpets with smashed peas and bacon, a quick, aromatic fish curry, and a golden pear & almond cake with orange drizzle, Jamie proves simple ingredients really can shine.

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E02 — Better Than Takeout: Indian-Spiced Lentils
Jamie makes frugal leftovers fun with spaghetti frittata, bakes air-fryer pork pies using affordable mince, and preps a batch of butternut squash dal. Plus, budget-friendly chicken shish kebabs and thrifty mint choc chip whoopie pies!

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E05 — Peperonata Eggs on Toast and Baked Cinnamon Apples
Jamie makes a no-cook store-cupboard olive pasta sauce, a cheap frozen-pepper peperonata stew with coddled eggs, a wallet-friendly chicken thigh and bean roast dinner, and budget-clever homemade takeaway kebabs with flatbreads!

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E01 — Not Your Nonna's Risotto
Jamie makes a low-cost dosa, crispy chicken, oozy barley risotto, beef stew and shortbread biscuits.

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E04 — Comforting Mushroom Soup and Cheesy Soda Bread
Jamie cooks a comforting mushroom soup with cheap air-fryer soda bread for under a fiver, stretches ham hocks into a second teardrop gnocchi meal, makes a low-cost air-fryer chicken burger takeaway clone, and bakes thrifty frozen-berry iced buns!

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E03 — Easy Stuffed Dumplings and British Fish & Chips
Jamie saves money with easy stuffed leftover dumplings, a budget frozen-fish chip shop cheat, a store-cupboard jar blondie cake, pocket-pleasing pork tacos, and a brilliant air-fryer tinned pineapple tarte tatin dessert!

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E06 — Easy Chicken Curry and Feta Tomato Pasta
Jamie makes an air-fryer tomato and roast feta pasta using leftover noodles, a budget rolled carrot cake, and a cheap family chicken curry. Plus, an epic cheese-on-toast Welsh rarebit upgrade and frozen fish Chinese-inspired dough parcels!

title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
description:
S01 E01 — Gochujang Chicken Sheet Pan Dinner
Jamie cooks a speedy midweek chicken tray bake. He shows us cool ways to upgrade salmon, knocks up a shelf-raid quesadilla toastie, and transforms a batch-cook Bolognese into cheesy bread bowls. All finished off with a super simple banoffee tart.

title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
description:
S01 E02 — Creamy Chicken Pot Pie and Chocolate Tiramisu
Jamie cooks a midweek traybake of roast veg and Camembert. He turns poached chicken into a creamy chicken & chive pie, serves up his easy green chilli salsa under sizzling butterflied prawns, and finishes it all off with decadent chocolate tiramisù.

title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
description:
S01 E03 — Easy Pantry Staple Fish Cakes
Jamie shares a simple salmon dish perfect for a midweek meal, and some no-fuss fish cakes made from tins. He cooks a lamb Madras traybake, as well as a no-cook pasta sauce, and crowns it all off with a hot and crispy ice cream parcel!

Jamie cooks a midweek meal of speedy sweet pea chicken, a juicy Smash burger and a chicken and mushroom rice traybake. He batch-cooks his seven-veg sauce, followed by a spicy fish soup. And finishes off with a perfect pudding of tinned fruit granita.

title: Backyard BBQ Hero
description:
S01 E05 — Santa Maria Tri-tip Hero
If you love outdoor grilling AND flexing your skills by entertaining guests, the next Backyard BBQ Hero is required viewing. Fire up the grill for a show-stopping Santa Maria-style tri tip, a zesty salad, and an unbelievable dinner bread!

title: Backyard BBQ Hero
description:
S01 E02 — Steakhouse Hero
Susie's bringing in a special guest so you can bring the steakhouse to your backyard! Christie Vanover of Girls Can Grill joins the fun and brings some fingerling potatoes to round out the ribeyes, asparagus, and a one-of-a-kind compound butter!

title: Backyard BBQ Hero
description:
S01 E01 — Weeknight Family Dinner Hero
Susie from Hey Grill Hey teaches you how to make a full family dinner right in your own backyard in under 30 minutes! When you serve this grilled honey mustard chicken, creamed corn, and mixed veggies, you'll feel like a Weeknight BBQ Hero!

title: Backyard BBQ Hero
description:
S01 E03 — Pulled Pork Party Hero
It's always kind of a party in the backyard, but it's really a party when Susie breaks out the smoker for some legendary pulled pork sliders, a homemade coleslaw, and a mac and cheese so creamy even the grownups will rave about it.

title: Backyard BBQ Hero
description:
S01 E06 — Smoked Brisket Hero
Pitmaster Jason Neeley (Pica Rica BBQ) drops by the backyard to share some insider tips for nailing the perfect brisket and helps Susie make pickled vegetables to go alongside her dad's hot potato salad! This is a must-watch for serious Pitmasters.

title: Backyard BBQ Hero
description:
S01 E04 — Mexican Carne Asada Hero
Grill fatigue is a very real problem, but the globally-inspired menu of carne asada, tomatillo salsa, Mexican street corn, and Tex-Mex beans in this episode of Backyard BBQ Hero is sure to reignite the fire inside and get you outside cooking!

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S09 E04 — Carne Asada with La Familia
Pati learns that carne asada goes way beyond grilled meat in Sonora. It's an important weekly ritual that brings the whole family together.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S09 E02 — Hermosillo Food Crawl
Pati spends a day in Sonora's capital, Hermosillo, visiting some of the city's best culinary destinations. From gigantic burritos at Doña Guille to Sonoran hot dogs, Pati experiences all Hermosillo's food scene has to offer.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S10 E08 — The Heart of Tequila
Pati visits the birthplace of Mexico's most famous spirit, the town of Tequila. Back home Pati makes a brunch of corn tortilla egg nests with salsa verde con chile de árbol and traditional arroz rojo.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S11 E10 — Top Chefs and Ancient Cliffs
Pati's climber friends take her on an adventure to the Sierra Madre mountains, followed by a quick elote snack. Later, Pati connects with four top chefs for a carne asada with a mountain backdrop.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S09 E05 — Flour Power
Pati tours one of Hermosillo's oldest flour mills and gets a lesson on making coyotas, a traditional dessert, at a local bakery. In her kitchen, Pati shares her take on a classic Sonoran recipe - a carne con chile burrito.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S10 E09 — Double Vallarta
Pati is in one of Mexico's most popular beach destinations - Puerto Vallarta. She gets an insider's tour of the best street food from one of the town's most acclaimed chefs, Thierry Boulet.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S12 E07 — The Famous Pastes of Spices
Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients that make recados unique.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S12 E06 — Yucatán Meats
Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S11 E04 — Bread Masters
Irving Quiroz wrote the book on Mexican bread. Pati visits his workshop for his secret to making the perfect campechana, then meets Chuy Elizondo, owner of one of the hottest brunch spots in town.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S12 E08 — Mayan Gateway To The Underworld
No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S10 E03 — Jalisco Classics
In Guadalajara, Pati learns the secrets to menudo and birria. In her kitchen, Pati perfects her own recipes for a few Jalisco favorites: menudo, tepache, and jericalla.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S09 E01 — Tucson: Gateway to Sonora
In Tucson, Pati learns the basics of artisan bread-making from Don Guerra of Barrio Bakery. She crosses into Sonora, Mexico, to see where the wheat is from. Back in her kitchen, Pati creates a menu of tasty recipes using wheat flour.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S05 E02 — Bring Your Own Lunch
These handheld lunches for work or school are easy on the wallet and customizable for the whole family.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S05 E08 — The Future is Flavor
Frankie harnesses the power of time to transform simple ingredients into flavorful goods that'll stick around for a long time. Learn the basics of preserving, pickling & curing to make dinner anything but a struggle. It just takes a little patience.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S05 E04 — How Do You Like Them Apples
Apples aren't just good for keeping the doctor away. Frankie demonstrates how to make the most of this beloved, everyday fruit, from sweet treats to savory meals. There's a whole world of apples to dive into, especially while they're in season.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S05 E09 — Pantry Pasta
It's no secret that pasta is Frankie's favorite; he's serving it up all night without even opening his fridge.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S05 E03 — Salad Salad Salad
Amp up your salad game with a little mixing and matching, from light and leafy greens to crisp and hearty toppings, and dressings for all occasions. Frankie shows us how versatile and fulfilling a homemade salad can truly be.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S05 E07 — Let's Play Ball
No matter who you're rooting for, savor these ballpark favorites while beating those major league prices.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S06 E07 — Piece Of The Pie
There may be infinite ways to define pie, but the only math that matters is what makes these sweet and savory dishes fit the bill. In true Struggle Style, Frankie rolls out his best tips and tricks for enjoying hassle-free, cost-friendly pies.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S06 E01 — Citrus Sunshine
Winter citrus is here to brighten up your day. Frankie is fixing up some light, zesty, and affordable recipes to add a little seasonal sunshine to your plate.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S06 E02 — Suppertime Superstar
From casual weeknights to special occasions, be the star of the dinnertime with these crowd-pleasing meals.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S06 E10 — Cry Me An Allium River
Frankie takes on his longtime frenemy, the onion, and all its powerful relatives. There might be a few tears shed along the way, but they are well worth the delicious and flavorful results, from sweet buttery leeks to the ultimate onion masterpiece.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S06 E06 — I Need To Eat Right Now
At the end of a long, hectic day, when you need dinner in a pinch, Frankie unlocks his not-so-secret formula for whipping up quick and easy meals, using minimal ingredients that will satisfy your cravings and feed the family in a flash.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S06 E05 — Fancy Pants Pasta
Treat yourself to a five-star pasta dinner, as Frankie cooks his signature dishes with showstopping sauces.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E08 — Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs
Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E09 — Tuna 101: Grilled, Poached and Raw
Chef Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole tuna and serves it three ways: grilled, raw, and poached.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E05 — The King of Open-Fire Paella
Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E09 — Wild Seafood Risotto
Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E06 — Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast
Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E10 — The Ultimate Elk Tailgate
It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E02 — Back to Our Caveman Roots
Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E10 — Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg
Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E05 — Bison Brats & Grilled Kebabs on Flatbread
Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.
